text: Text someone you have not talked to recently and ask how they are doing.
Say hi to the next person you pass, and use their name if you know it.
Send a friend or family member a photo or memory that made you think of them.
Give one real compliment to someone near you right now.
Ask someone: what was the best part of your day so far?
Thank someone for something they did this week. Be specific.
Put your phone face down for your next conversation, start to finish.
Invite someone to sit with you, or ask to sit with them, at your next meal.
Ask a teacher, coach or staff member how their day is going, and listen to the answer.
Message someone in your family just to check in. No reason needed.
